title: GQL-24-C: reconcile REST/MCP/CLI with the old LifeOps GraphQL PoC (no hand-written parser copy)
claim: The old LifeOps GraphQL PoC schema can be served by a real GraphQL engine (async-graphql 7.2.1) with no hand-written parser. The repo lockfile does NOT already have it; the crates are available offline in the local cargo registry cache.

commands.result: POC_QUERY_OK (357 B of data), INTROSPECTION_OK=true, MUTATION_OK, ERROR_OK all present

evidence.claim: The repo lockfile does NOT contain async-graphql. This corrects an earlier wrong claim.
evidence.detail: Cargo.lock is 147,774 bytes; `grep -c async-graphql Cargo.lock` returns 0. The repo does not already depend on a GraphQL crate.

evidence.claim: A real GraphQL engine is available offline in the local cargo registry cache, so no network is needed.
evidence.detail: async-graphql-7.2.1.crate (335,797 B), async-graphql-derive-7.2.1.crate, async-graphql-parser-7.2.1.crate, async-graphql-value-7.2.1.crate, pest 2.9.1 (the parser backend). Extracted sources exist under registry/src/. Vendoring is unnecessary.

evidence.claim: The PoC's own query parses and resolves on the real engine, with zero hand-written parser code.
evidence.detail: POC_QUERY_OK returns runs[] with run_id/status/stage/tool_calls/iteration, recentRun, and context(run_id). 357 bytes of data. probe/src/main.rs is 6,194 bytes and imports only async_graphql.

evidence.claim: The schema is self-discoverable by introspection.
Mutations round-trip (spawnRun, submitProposal) with all PoC fields.
evidence.detail: MUTATION_OK returns spawnRun{run_id,status} and submitProposal{proposal_id,run_id,status,created_at} as one JSON data object.

evidence.claim: Bad queries yield GraphQL errors, not crashes (proper semantics).
The REST surface is a fixed route table that a GraphQL layer must sit beside, not replace.
evidence.detail: api_router() mounts 66 .route(...) calls over 54 distinct paths (blueprints, runs, agents, interactions, mcp, tools, scripts, config, /ws).

evidence.claim: The MCP surface is a fixed tool table over the same daemon core.
evidence.detail: tool_table() lists 16 tools: run, wait, status, result, cancel, message, respond, list_runs, list_agents, install_tool, list_tools, ps, pause, resume, daemon_status, validate. call_tool has 15 match arms (ps reuses list_runs). Both REST and MCP bridge to the same ControlRequest / run-record core.

evidence.claim: The repo has no existing GraphQL server; the only 'graphql' hits are a file-format label.
evidence.detail: grep for graphql across crates/*.rs finds only validate/format.rs and validate/format/tests.rs. This matches the PoC's Step 1 recon.

notes: Probe source lives in probe/ inside the workdir. It reuses the warm cargo target dir at /tmp/gqlprobe/target (~613 MB) to avoid a large rebuild. probe_raw.txt holds the first failed attempt (camelCase default field names); probe_out.txt is the passing run after explicit #[graphql(name=...)] snake_case attributes.
